title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-009
doc_notes: This is a transcript of a FAA/AAL interview with a JAL First Officer regarding a UFO sighting; encounter content is present.

encounters.summary: JAL First Officer Takanori Tamefuji reports sighting unidentified lights while in flight, which he initially mistook for an oncoming aircraft.
encounters.entity_appearance: Multiple lights, described as salmon, red, orange, white, and weak green blinking lights.
encounters.entity_behavior: Moving in a swinging motion, maintaining a formation, and appearing to travel with the aircraft.
encounters.quote: I am certain that I saw something.
